text:
anna_sales: FYI Helix onboarding is moving fast. POC asks: EU-only data residency, SIG Lite questionnaire responses by EOW, MSA indemnity cap move from 3x fees to 1x for POC only, and an order form that shows reserved capacity + short-term overage pricing. They also want net-45 and split invoicing by department code. Can legal + finance weigh in?

claire_se: Tech note from infra call: POC needs 4xA10G reserved with burst to hosted. They'll push up sequence lengths (avg 1.2k) so need KV cache enabled. Also they'll require IP allowlist + brief SAML cert exchange for SSO.

oliver_ae: Pricing sketch (internal): 
```
Product: Dedicated POC - 4xA10G reserved
Term: 8 weeks POC
Commit: $22,400 / month (pro-rated)
Overage (hosted fallback): $0.005 / token for spikes
Onboarding/VPC: $3,000 one-time
```
They said billing should show three department codes in a single invoice lines (no separate vendor records).

rafael_legal: On indemnity cap: we can accept 1x fees for the POC only if we carve out willful misconduct and IP infringement; need to keep broader MSA cap for production. Also EU-only residency: we need to map subprocessors and contractually bind them to EU processing for that customer. For SIG Lite: I can push draft answers but will need their customer security contact for a couple clarifications (audit logs retention, key management).

emily_finance: Net-45 ok for enterprise POCs with credit approval. Need Helix legal entity + tax ID + PO format. For single invoice with multiple department charge lines, finance requires the department codes and % splits. If they want separate billing entities, that will require separate vendor onboarding.

anna_sales: Helix prefers single invoice with department lines. I'll get tax ID + PO format. They asked if we can temporarily lower invoice frequency to monthly even if POC < 1 month 1 billing cycles questions.

rafael_legal: For MSA/MSA+Orderform flow: propose MSA baseline countersigned by Redwood legal, order form contains POC-specific caps/residency and signatures. If they want exec sign on MSA, escalate but recommend keeping execs off the MSA for speed.

claire_se: Ops question: if we do EU-only residency, do we have an EU region reserved capacity for the POC start date (tentative next Tue)? @anna_sales need to confirm start date ASAP.

anna_sales: Tentative start Tue 2026-04-14, will confirm today. Also will request SAML cert + IP allowlist and dept codes from Helix procurement.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope (env_hl_42) prepped by anna_sales. Recipients: Helix Procurement -> Helix CFO -> Redwood Legal -> Redwood AE. Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/env_hl_42

emily_finance: I'll provision a credit check. If they pass, net-45 approved and we can accept single invoice with department lines. Please send vendor legal name and PO sample.

rafael_legal: I'll upload a redline for the DPA/MSA carve and the suggested SIG Lite answers by EOD. Will flag any escalations needed.

anna_sales: Action items: (1) @rafael_legal upload DPA/MSA redlines + SIG answers EOD, (2) @emily_finance confirm credit check ETA, (3) @claire_se confirm EU-capacity availability once start date locked, (4) I'll collect SAML cert, IP allowlist, PO format, and tax ID and kick the envelope. Will update thread. ✅
